capabilities: Display a configurable homepage with banner, calendar, shortcuts, and two-column module layout
Add, edit, complete, and schedule recurring tasks that rewrite the source Markdown
Open or create daily notes from a calendar with fallback to core Daily notes settings
List active notes filtered by configured folders and tags
Apply theme presets to dashboard text, borders, and module accents
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide theme; its theme presets color only the dashboard and leave vault CSS snippets untouched.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true); it cannot be installed on mobile. Not yet in the community plugin market — install manually from Releases or via BRAT. No third-party plugins, network, account, or telemetry required.
intentEvidence: Evolution replaces what a dataviewjs calendar plus a dataview TASK query used to do
motivation: The author built it partly so the homepage no longer depends on Dataview, replacing dataviewjs calendars and dataview TASK queries.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page, so users assemble dashboards from Dataview queries, embedded calendars, and manual layouts.

summary: Configurable homepage dashboard with a banner, daily-note calendar, shortcuts, task list, and active-note list, writing all edits back to source notes.
